rule_text.name: 702.279a
rule_text.rule: Refine represents two static abilities that function while the spell with refine is on the stack. “Refine [cost]” means “You may cast this spell by paying [cost] and sacrificing an artifact rather than paying its mana cost” and “If you chose to pay this spell’s refine cost, its total cost is reduced by an amount of generic mana equal to the sacrificed artifact’s mana value.” Casting a spell using its refine ability follows the rules for paying alternative costs in rules 601.2b and 601.2f–h.

rule_text.name: 702.279b
rule_text.rule: You choose which artifact to sacrifice as you choose to pay a spell’s refine cost (see rule 601.2b), and you sacrifice that artifact as you pay the total cost (see rule 601.2h).
